envelope.description: Add the completion hook and the first-author exception to the gate

body.title: Add the completion hook and the first-author exception to the gate
body.summary: In src/workflow/team/gate.ts add CompletionHook and registerCompletionHook, consult the registered hook for author and build on a next stage and for open-signoff, revise and release (a throwing hook refuses with its message; none registered continues), give the hook's own release a non-recursive internal path that skips the hook, and return no-issue for a stage whose issue cannot be resolved or created, with allowFirstAuthor true only for the first author turn of a stage that has no artifact yet; any other action on such a stage is refused.
acceptanceChecks: The completion hook is consulted for the listed actions, a release from the hook does not consult it again, and with none registered the gate continues
A throwing hook refuses with its message and never throws
The first author turn of a stage with no issue and no artifact is allowed and any other action on a stage with no issue is refused
A missing issue that ensureUnitIssue can create is created and the gate then decides

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/gate.test.ts: the first author turn of a stage with no issue and no artifact is allowed as an explicit exception and any other action on a stage with no issue is refused

src/workflow/team/__tests__/gate.test.ts: the registered completion hook is consulted for author and build on a next stage and for open-signoff, revise and release, a release called by the hook does not consult it again, and with none registered the gate behaves as continue (a hook-contract test; the completion-releases-the-claim integration test belongs to s7)

src/workflow/team/__tests__/gate.test.ts: each port failure kind, several assignees, an unreadable policy, a missing issue and a throwing completion hook map to refused or no-issue with the reason and never throw
